name: Basic AMQ JMS Producer
helpText: This Spring-based JMS producer connects to vendor-specific brokers such as ActiveMQ, HornetQ and IBM MQ. Add the libraries required by the selected broker to the integration module.

sessionTransacted.helpText:
sessionTransacted

A boolean that controls whether the JMS session used to send messages operates within a local transaction. It defaults to false.

What it does

It is passed to jmsTemplate.setSessionTransacted(...) and to connection.createSession(sessionTransacted, sessionAcknowledgeMode) when the producer's session is created.

When true — the send is wrapped in a local JMS transaction; the message is only committed to the broker when the session commits.
When false — the message is sent immediately, governed by sessionAcknowledgeMode instead.

Local transaction vs. XA/distributed transaction

This is a local JMS-only transaction — it only covers the JMS session itself, not any downstream database or other resource. For an atomic send alongside other work (e.g. a database write), use XA via an Arjuna/JTA-managed connection factory instead.

Typical usage

Fire-and-forget (most common, lower overhead):

.setSessionTransacted(false) // default — can be omitted

When the send must be atomic with other local session work:

.setSessionTransacted(true)
